description: Single, wages + interest: 2026 reduced rates, one $2,000 exemption
Joint, both 65+, wages + investment income: senior modification of $8,000 each, joint return uses the same schedule as single
working: IT-140: federal AGI 105,000 (West Virginia gives no capital gains preference). Schedule M line 47 senior modification: each spouse 65+ has at least 8,000 of income not otherwise subtracted (no pension or Social Security subtractions), so 2 x 8,000 = 16,000. Line 4 West Virginia AGI = 89,000. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000 = 4,000. Line 7 = 85,000. Schedule I (joint): over 60,000 -> 1,950.50 + 4.58% x 25,000 = 1,950.50 + 1,145.00 = 3,095.50. Federal: standard 32,200 + 2 x 1,650 = 35,500; senior deduction 2 x 6,000 = 12,000 (AGI under 150,000); TI = 105,000 - 35,500 - 12,000 = 57,500; ordinary part 12,500 -> 1,250; 45,000 of gains/dividends in the 0% band; tax 1,250.
